options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: create_user
options.description: When enabled, will create a new user and group based on the values of I(service_user) and I(service_group) This parameter does not apply for native installations.

options.name: download_location
options.description: Optional directory path to which the installer will be downloaded.  If not selected, then a temporary directory will be created in the default System Temp Directory.  When choosing an alternate directory, the directory and installer will not be deleted at the end of the execution.

options.name: download_uri
options.description: The download uri from where the installer can be downloaded

options.name: file_based
options.description: When enabled, will install the agent in non-LVM mode and support only file based backups.

options.name: native_package
options.description: When enabled, native installer packages are used based on the operating system

options.name: operating_system
options.description: ansible_distribution from facts, this value is automatically populated. Not given by module user

options.name: service_group
options.description: Group underwhich permissions will be configured for the Cohesity Agent configuration. This group must exist unless I(create_user=True) is also configured. This parameter doesn't apply for native installation.

options.name: service_user
options.description: Username underwhich the Cohesity Agent will be installed and run. This user must exist unless I(create_user=True) is also configured. This user must be an existing user for native installation.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines if the agent should be C(present) or C(absent) from the host

options.name: upgrade
options.description: If set to true and agent is already installed in the source, agent will be upgraded.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.
